input.value: slip and fall on icy walkway; child broke wrist

input.rationale: Third-party child was injured (broken wrist) due to icy condition on the policyholder's walkway during an ice storm; injury to a third party's person arising from premises condition is classic liability.

Pediatric injury (nine-year-old with broken wrist) requires prompt adjuster investigation; medical bills and potential ongoing treatment elevate this beyond minor injury threshold, and future complications are possible.

input.claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm last week, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are anticipated to submit medical bills. Pediatric injury and property-condition liability require prompt adjuster contact.
